_comment: Merge the parts you want into ~/.claude/settings.json (user level). JSON has no comments, so these _comment keys are only notes; Claude Code ignores unknown keys, but you can delete them.
Replace {REPO} with the absolute path of this repository and {MEMORIA} with your memory folder, using forward slashes, also on Windows (D:/work/home-ai, not D:\work\home-ai).

HOOKS ARE OFF in this template: they sit under "_hooks_disabled". To switch one on, copy its event block (e.g. "PreCompact": [...]) into a real "hooks" object in your settings.json, with the owner's yes. Switch them on one by one.

The hook commands use `py -3.12` (the Windows Python launcher, INSTALL ch. 0); on Linux/macOS write python3.12. Hooks never block: each script always exits 0. If you can't see a hook's effect, check the path first. The two SessionStart hooks append a line to {MEMORIA}/naplo/*_nyom.log ('nyom' = trace) when they run; the PreCompact hook writes {MEMORIA}/naplo/tomoritesek.md and the handover file.
_comment_autoCompactWindow: The token count at which Claude Code compacts the context automatically. 650000 was our value for a model with a 1M-token context window; pick a value that fits YOUR model's context size (well below it). Set the context meter's meter_threshold in figyelok.json (chapter 3) a little below this value (about 65 % of the context window: 130000 for a 200k model, ~590000 for a 1M model).

_hooks_disabled._comment_PreCompact: precompact_mentes.py: before every compaction, one line into {MEMORIA}/naplo/tomoritesek.md and a handover file {MEMORIA}/kontextus/atado_<session8>.md with the last turns (and the MOOD lines kept on top).
_hooks_disabled._comment_SessionStart: compact: postcompact_emlekezteto.py tells the continuing instance where the handover is and which journal file is today's. startup|resume: sessionstart_figyelo_emlekezteto.py reports the machine/daemon state and lists the watchers to start again (from karbantartas/figyelok.json; copy figyelok.example.json first).

_comment_env: Every key inside "env" becomes a real environment variable for Claude Code and its tools. TELEGRAM_MCP_CONFIG is added here in chapter 6 of INSTALL.md, after the bot exists.
